Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Check out our Forbes Fintech 50 and CNBC and Statista's World's Top Fintech Companies 2026!

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.

Role Description

Prediction markets are one of Phantom's top priorities, and the category is still wide open. The interfaces everyone uses today are not the end state. As a Senior Product Manager on the Predictions team, you'll shape what trading on real-world events should feel like, from five-minute crypto markets to live sports, politics, and culture.

You'll start with something most prediction products spend years building: more than 20 million people who already hold and trade their money in Phantom, tokens, perps, and stablecoins in the same app. We're looking for someone with the creativity to use that, the judgment to decide what matters, and the drive to see it through without waiting to be asked.

Responsibilities

  • Define how Phantom wins in a competitive market. Build on our funded user base, crypto infrastructure, and existing trading products to make discovering, funding, and trading predictions simpler and more connected.

  • Own the prediction markets experience end to end, from discovery to payout.

  • Sweat the design details with our designers. Make trading simpler for someone placing a first prediction and more powerful for someone placing their fiftieth of the day.

  • Build a team that stays close to traders. Talk to them every week, read support tickets, and dogfood every build. Turn what you learn into roadmap decisions, and make these habits part of how the team works.

  • Make every trade trustworthy. Own trade execution, position and PnL accuracy, and clear market resolution, so traders can rely on every number on the screen.

  • Own market discovery and retention. Decide which markets we list and feature, how we surface live events, and how personalization, notifications, and social features give traders reasons to return.

  • Make the calls. Decide what to build, what to cut, and when something is ready to ship, often with incomplete information, and own the outcome.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, design, data, marketing, legal, and our exchange and liquidity partners to ship in a regulated category. Set shared goals and report progress every week, including what isn't working.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years as a full-time Product Manager or founder, including a consumer product you owned end to end and grew through measurable improvements in adoption, retention, or revenue.

  • You trade yourself (prediction markets, perps, crypto, or something more exotic) and have strong opinions about which products do it well. Comfortable reasoning about order books, liquidity, pricing, and settlement.

  • Original product thinking, with a record of turning what you learned from users into something new that people adopted.

  • Strong design sensibility. You can point to work where you made something simpler without taking power away from the people who wanted it.

  • You stay close to users and use AI agents and data to test what you hear, investigate product performance, and measure whether your decisions worked.

  • You pick up problems without being asked and see them through. You know when to gather more evidence and when to make a call.

  • A close collaborator. You can lead engineering, design, legal, and marketing without formal authority, and you're technical enough to work through exchange, onchain, and data integrations in detail.

  • Bonus points if you have:

    • Worked at a prediction market, sportsbook, exchange, or brokerage.

    • Built something on crypto rails that could not have been built without them.

    • Built real-time, live-event, or high-frequency trading products.

Why Work With Us

Phantom's journey to becoming a global trading app began with making crypto easier to use. Today, we’re building on that foundation to help people discover the markets that matter, make informed financial moves, and safely store or spend their money worldwide. Joining Phantom means helping shape that next chapter: building products that bring the freedom of open markets to more people.

 

  • Build for global impact: Create products used by tens of millions of people, making innovative financial markets more accessible to users around the world.

  • Make complexity feel simple: Solve meaningful challenges across design, engineering, and user experience to make discovering markets and managing money seamless.

  • Put users in control: Help build a future where people have greater freedom over their assets and financial decisions, with security and self-custody at the foundation.

Benefits (only available to full-time employees)

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision): base plan 100% covered

  • Flexible hours and a long-standing, supportive remote environment

  • Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Wellness stipend

  • Weekly meal stipend

  • Learning & Development stipend

  • Remote / WFH set-up stipend

We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career.

By submitting your resume and application materials, you acknowledge and agree that Phantom Technologies, Inc. ("Phantom") collects and processes your personal information (including application materials, interview records, and related data) to evaluate your candidacy. Phantom may use AI-powered tools and third-party service providers for transcription, note-taking, scheduling, and other administrative tasks. Phantom does not sell your information and your materials will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken’s world-class Security Team is growing. As we continue to scale and mature our information technology controls program, we are seeking a senior professional with a strong background in risk management to help build and operate a program designed for enterprise scale.

Kraken is seeking a Senior Risk Analyst to join the Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (SecGRC) team. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Security Risk Management, this role is a key contributor to the execution and maturation of Kraken's Security Risk Management program. You'll conduct rigorous risk assessments, produce high-quality analysis, and help build the operational infrastructure that makes the program run — all in close partnership with program leadership. This role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact both within Kraken and across the broader industry.

The ideal candidate is deeply analytical, process-minded, and energized by turning ambiguous risk signals into clear, repeatable, and scalable workflows. Entrepreneurial spirit and comfort with iterating quickly is a must. This is a fully remote role.

 

The opportunity

  • Execute security risk assessments end-to-end — scoping, data gathering, analysis, findings documentation, and communicating results to stakeholders — in alignment with program methodology set by leadership

  • Support the development and continuous refinement of risk assessment templates, workflows, and process guides that make the program consistent and scalable

  • Maintain risk registers and ensure identified risks are tracked accurately and progressing through mitigation, remediation, or acceptance workflows

  • Assist in building and maintaining Key Risk Indicators (KRI) tracking and risk reporting outputs, translating raw data into clear, well-structured deliverables for review by senior leadership

  • Partner with technical teams including Vulnerability Management, Application Security, and Blue Team to gather risk-relevant data and incorporate operational findings into assessment work

  • Identify opportunities to streamline and automate risk processes and bring those recommendations to program leadership for prioritization

  • Contribute to the documentation and upkeep of risk program standards, procedures, and guidance materials

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Compliance, Internal Audit, Engineering, and Legal to ensure risk findings are well-contextualized and properly actioned

  • Support audit preparedness activities and risk-related reporting as directed by program leadership

 

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in information security risk management, cybersecurity governance, or GRC

  • Hands-on experience conducting risk assessments and owning findings documentation — not just supporting assessments, but running them

  • Strong working knowledge of risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27005, PCI DSS, or DoCRA

  • Demonstrated ability to build repeatable processes — you've taken something ad hoc and made it structured and scalable

  • Strong data analysis skills; able to clean, interpret, and present risk data clearly and accurately

  • Experience contributing to KRI tracking and risk reporting for internal stakeholder audiences

  • Familiarity with GRC tools such as AuditBoard, Archer, OneTrust, or ServiceNow GRC

  • Proficient in Google Workspace; SQL and/or Tableau experience a strong plus

  • Excellent written communication — your deliverables are clear, well-organized, and don't require heavy editing

  • Self-directed and comfortable operating in ambiguity; you take direction well and run with it

  • Bachelor's degree or above in IT, Cybersecurity, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field

  • CISM, CRISC, or ISO 27001 credentials a plus; experience in fintech or regulated industries preferred

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you’ll be responsible for:

Circle has built its reputation on being compliant and transparent. That reputation rests on data that is right.

As a Data Engineer at Circle, you'll build and operate the pipelines and data models that our risk and compliance teams depend on to monitor activity, screen for risk, meet regulatory reporting requirements and produce evidence that stands up to scrutiny. You'll work with large-scale on-chain and internal data and turn it into datasets that people can trust, explain and defend. You'll join a team of passionate engineers who care about data reliability, learn from experienced senior and staff engineers, and take on a growing share of ownership as you go. If you pay close attention to detail, get bothered when the numbers don't tie out, are excited to learn from our expert risk and compliance partners, and want to understand how our systems really work, we would love to talk to you.


What you'll work on:

  • Partner with product engineering, risk, compliance, data analytics and data science teams to understand what data they need and why, and help turn those needs into well-specified requirements, models, business logic and pipelines.
  • Develop a working understanding of how the business thinks about risk and compliance obligations, such as transaction monitoring, sanctions and AML screening, regulatory reporting and audit evidence, and how our data supports each one.
  • Own the pipelines and models you build, including on-call for them. Write and maintain runbooks, add data quality checks and alerting, and fix root causes rather than symptoms when something breaks.
  • Work with on-chain data at scale, ingesting and modeling data from multiple blockchains and handling the realities of that data, such as reorgs, late or missing records and upstream schema changes.
  • Deliver new sources, domain models and backfills with limited supervision. Escalate early on large or ambiguous efforts, and bring ideas for better approaches to your senior teammates.
  • Apply access and control requirements correctly in your own work, such as authorized views and PII handling, and flag gaps you find.
  • Build scalable automated solutions using SQL, Python, orchestration and transformation tooling, and AI.
  • Review peers' code and models, document what you ship, and keep your partners informed on progress and risks.

You will aspire to our four core values:


  • Multistakeholder - you have dedication and commitment to our customers, shareholders, employees and families and local communities.
  • Mindful - you seek to be respectful, an active listener and to pay attention to detail.
  • Driven by Excellence - you are driven by our mission and our passion for customer success which means you relentlessly pursue excellence, that you do not tolerate mediocrity and you work intensely to achieve your goals.
  • High Integrity - you seek open and honest communication, and you hold yourself to very high moral and ethical standards. You reject manipulation, dishonesty and intolerance.

What you’ll bring to Circle:

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical field (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Finance or similar), or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience building and operating production data pipelines and models.
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python, and experience with a modern data stack: a cloud data warehouse, an orchestrator such as Airflow, and a transformation tool such as dbt.
  • A track record of delivering well-scoped work independently, with high-quality, tested code and few errors.
  • Clear communication and a collaborative approach, including the ability to explain to non-technical partners how the pipelines you build work.
  • A strong sense of ownership: when a number looks wrong or a pipeline breaks, you dig in, find the root cause, and keep partners informed until it is fixed.
  • Experience with blockchain data, financial services, risk, compliance, banking or other regulated industries is a plus, but not required.

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

The role

Gauntlet is looking for an AI Research Engineer to help improve how we build, evaluate and use AI agents across the business.

We already have agents running in production, including Aria, our in-house generalist agent. They're used across research, engineering and business workflows, and we've learned a lot from seeing how they perform in practice. Some tasks work extremely well; others produce inconsistent results, and changes to models or tooling can introduce unexpected problems. Today, much of that feedback is still subjective. We want to build a more systematic way of understanding what works, what doesn't and why.

A major part of this role will be building the evaluation frameworks that allow us to measure agent performance on real tasks. You'll work with our engineers, quantitative researchers and other teams to understand where agents struggle, turn those observations into measurable experiments, and use the results to improve the systems we're building.

You'll also contribute directly to our existing agents and internal tooling. Initially, the work will be more engineering-focused as you get familiar with our systems, shipping improvements and integrations that teams can use. Over time, you'll take on more open-ended research, helping us develop better approaches to evaluation, agent behaviour and infrastructure.

We're also thinking beyond individual agents. One of our longer-term goals is to build a shared system of knowledge and reusable skills that our agents can draw from and improve over time. You'll play an important role in developing that infrastructure and how we evaluate its effectiveness.

This is an applied research role with a meaningful engineering component. We're looking for someone who enjoys investigating difficult problems, can design good experiments and is comfortable building and shipping the solutions that come out of them.
